run_get_flops: run the get_flops script to calculate FLOPs and parameters for an mmdet detector model from a config file
test_inference: test the inference function to compute average FLOPs across multiple image batches from a validation dataloader
parse_args: parse command-line arguments including config path, number of images, and cfg-options for model complexity analysis
build_model_flops: build an mmdet model from config and compute its FLOPs and parameter count using get_model_complexity_info
summarize_main: summarize the main entry point that orchestrates FLOPs calculation and prints input shape, FLOPs, and params
